# CONTROL: is the low conservation of the 8E1M Tim44 interface in TIN-44 worm-specific,
# or is the same interface equally divergent between yeast and human?
import requests, numpy as np, pandas as pd
from scipy.stats import fisher_exact
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
HD={"User-Agent":"Mozilla/5.0"}
def txt(u):
    r=requests.get(u,headers=HD,timeout=120); r.raise_for_status(); return r.text
B62_txt="""   A  R  N  D  C  Q  E  G  H  I  L  K  M  F  P  S  T  W  Y  V
A  4 -1 -2 -2  0 -1 -1  0 -2 -1 -1 -1 -1 -2 -1  1  0 -3 -2  0
R -1  5  0 -2 -3  1  0 -2  0 -3 -2  2 -1 -3 -2 -1 -1 -3 -2 -3
N -2  0  6  1 -3  0  0  0  1 -3 -3  0 -2 -3 -2  1  0 -4 -2 -3
D -2 -2  1  6 -3  0  2 -1 -1 -3 -4 -1 -3 -3 -1  0 -1 -4 -3 -3
C  0 -3 -3 -3  9 -3 -4 -3 -3 -1 -1 -3 -1 -2 -3 -1 -1 -2 -2 -1
Q -1  1  0  0 -3  5  2 -2  0 -3 -2  1  0 -3 -1  0 -1 -2 -1 -2
E -1  0  0  2 -4  2  5 -2  0 -3 -3  1 -2 -3 -1  0 -1 -3 -2 -2
G  0 -2  0 -1 -3 -2 -2  6 -2 -4 -4 -2 -3 -3 -2  0 -2 -2 -3 -3
H -2  0  1 -1 -3  0  0 -2  8 -3 -3 -1 -2 -1 -2 -1 -2 -2  2 -3
I -1 -3 -3 -3 -1 -3 -3 -4 -3  4  2 -3  1  0 -3 -2 -1 -3 -1  3
L -1 -2 -3 -4 -1 -2 -3 -4 -3  2  4 -2  2  0 -3 -2 -1 -2 -1  1
K -1  2  0 -1 -3  1  1 -2 -1 -3 -2  5 -1 -3 -1  0 -1 -3 -2 -2
M -1 -1 -2 -3 -1  0 -2 -3 -2  1  2 -1  5  0 -2 -1 -1 -1 -1  1
F -2 -3 -3 -3 -2 -3 -3 -3 -1  0  0 -3  0  6 -4 -2 -2  1  3 -1
P -1 -2 -2 -1 -3 -1 -1 -2 -2 -3 -3 -1 -2 -4  7 -1 -1 -4 -3 -2
S  1 -1  1  0 -1  0  0  0 -1 -2 -2  0 -1 -2 -1  4  1 -3 -2 -2
T  0 -1  0 -1 -1 -1 -1 -2 -2 -1 -1 -1 -1 -2 -1  1  5 -2 -2  0
W -3 -3 -4 -4 -2 -2 -3 -2 -2 -3 -2 -3 -1  1 -4 -3 -2 11  2 -3
Y -2 -2 -2 -3 -2 -1 -2 -3  2 -1 -1 -2 -1  3 -3 -2 -2  2  7 -1
V  0 -3 -3 -3 -1 -2 -2 -3 -3  3  1 -2  1 -1 -2 -2  0 -3 -1  4"""
rows=B62_txt.strip().split("\n"); aal=rows[0].split(); IDX={c:i for i,c in enumerate(aal)}
Bm=np.full((21,21),-4.0)
for line in rows[1:]:
    p=line.split()
    for j,x in enumerate(p[1:]): Bm[IDX[p[0]],IDX[aal[j]]]=float(x)
enc=lambda s: np.array([IDX.get(c,20) for c in s])
def sc(a,b): return Bm[IDX.get(a,20),IDX.get(b,20)]
def nw_fast(s1,s2,go=-11.0,ge=-1.0):
    n,m=len(s1),len(s2); NEG=-1e9
    S=Bm[np.ix_(enc(s1),enc(s2))]
    Mp=np.full(m+1,NEG);Xp=np.full(m+1,NEG);Yp=np.full(m+1,NEG);Mp[0]=0.0
    for j in range(1,m+1): Yp[j]=go+ge*(j-1)
    ptr=np.zeros((n+1,m+1,3),np.int8); ptr[0,1:,2]=2; ar=np.arange(m)
    for i in range(1,n+1):
        M=np.full(m+1,NEG);X=np.full(m+1,NEG);Y=np.full(m+1,NEG)
        X[0]=go+ge*(i-1); ptr[i,0,1]=1
        c=np.vstack([Mp[:-1],Xp[:-1],Yp[:-1]]); k=np.argmax(c,0); M[1:]=c[k,ar]+S[i-1]; ptr[i,1:,0]=k
        c=np.vstack([Mp[1:]+go,Xp[1:]+ge,Yp[1:]+go]); k=np.argmax(c,0); X[1:]=c[k,ar]; ptr[i,1:,1]=k
        for j in range(1,m+1):
            cc=(M[j-1]+go,X[j-1]+go,Y[j-1]+ge); kk=int(np.argmax(cc)); Y[j]=cc[kk]; ptr[i,j,2]=kk
        Mp,Xp,Yp=M,X,Y
    i,j=n,m; st=int(np.argmax((Mp[m],Xp[m],Yp[m]))); A=[];Bb=[]
    while i>0 or j>0:
        if st==0: A.append(s1[i-1]);Bb.append(s2[j-1]);ns=ptr[i,j,0];i-=1;j-=1;st=ns
        elif st==1: A.append(s1[i-1]);Bb.append('-');ns=ptr[i,j,1];i-=1;st=ns
        else: A.append('-');Bb.append(s2[j-1]);ns=ptr[i,j,2];j-=1;st=ns
        if i==0 and j>0 and st!=2: st=2
        if j==0 and i>0 and st!=1: st=1
    return "".join(reversed(A)),"".join(reversed(Bb))
def mapping(ref,qry):
    A,B=nw_fast(ref,qry); i=j=0; mp={}
    for x,y in zip(A,B):
        if x!='-': i+=1
        if y!='-': j+=1
        if x!='-': mp[i]=(j if y!='-' else None,x,y)
    return mp
accs={"WORM":"O02161","YEAST":"Q01852","HUMAN":"O43615"}
seqs={k:"".join(txt(f"https://rest.uniprot.org/uniprotkb/{v}.fasta").strip().split("\n")[1:]) for k,v in accs.items()}
mp_yw=mapping(seqs["YEAST"],seqs["WORM"])
mp_yh=mapping(seqs["YEAST"],seqs["HUMAN"])

iface_res=[155,158,159,161,162,163,164,165,167,168,170,171,172,173,264,265,266,267,268,270,271,274,275,278,
           284,286,287,342,344,345,347,372,374,390,391,392,393,428,429,430,431]
lipid_res=[162,163,171,347,430]

def stats(mp,label,subset=None):
    alln=[r for r in mp if mp[r][0] is not None]
    bgi=sum(1 for r in alln if mp[r][1]==mp[r][2]); bgs=sum(1 for r in alln if sc(mp[r][1],mp[r][2])>0)
    S=subset or iface_res
    ok=[r for r in S if r in mp and mp[r][0] is not None]
    ni=sum(1 for r in ok if mp[r][1]==mp[r][2]); ns=sum(1 for r in ok if sc(mp[r][1],mp[r][2])>0)
    orr,p=fisher_exact([[ni,len(ok)-ni],[bgi-ni,(len(alln)-bgi)-(len(ok)-ni)]])
    print(f"{label}: interface identity {ni}/{len(ok)} = {100*ni/len(ok):.0f}% | background {bgi}/{len(alln)} = {100*bgi/len(alln):.1f}% | OR={orr:.2f} p={p:.3f} | interface similarity {100*ns/len(ok):.0f}% vs bg {100*bgs/len(alln):.0f}%")
    return dict(ni=ni,n=len(ok),bgi=bgi,bg=len(alln),pct=100*ni/len(ok),bgpct=100*bgi/len(alln),p=p)

print("=== CONTROL: conservation of the 8E1M Tim44/Tim17/Tim23 interface, yeast reference ===")
r_w=stats(mp_yw,"yeast -> C. elegans TIN-44")
r_h=stats(mp_yh,"yeast -> human TIMM44   ")
print("\n=== lipid-contacting Tim44 residues (CDL/PTY in 8E1M) ===")
for mp,lab in [(mp_yw,"worm"),(mp_yh,"human")]:
    out=[]
    for r in lipid_res:
        q=mp.get(r)
        out.append(f"{seqs['YEAST'][r-1]}{r}->{q[2]}{q[0]}" if q and q[0] else f"{r}->gap")
    print(f"  {lab}: "+", ".join(out))

# per-position table across all three
tabrows=[]
for r in iface_res:
    qw=mp_yw.get(r); qh=mp_yh.get(r)
    tabrows.append([f"{seqs['YEAST'][r-1]}{r}",
                    f"{qh[2]}{qh[0]}" if qh and qh[0] else "gap",
                    f"{qw[2]}{qw[0]}" if qw and qw[0] else "gap",
                    "Y" if qh and qh[0] and qh[1]==qh[2] else "n",
                    "Y" if qw and qw[0] and qw[1]==qw[2] else "n",
                    "lipid" if r in lipid_res else ""])
T=pd.DataFrame(tabrows,columns=["yeast","human","worm","id_yeast_human","id_yeast_worm","note"])
print("\n"+T.to_string(index=False))
both=((T.id_yeast_human=="Y")&(T.id_yeast_worm=="Y")).sum()
print(f"\ninterface positions identical in all three: {both}/{len(T)}")

fig,ax=plt.subplots(figsize=(7,4.2))
lab=["yeast->human\nTIMM44","yeast->worm\nTIN-44"]
ifa=[r_h['pct'],r_w['pct']]; bgv=[r_h['bgpct'],r_w['bgpct']]
x=np.arange(2); w=0.35
ax.bar(x-w/2,ifa,w,label='Tim17/Tim23 interface residues',color='#2b6cb0')
ax.bar(x+w/2,bgv,w,label='all aligned positions',color='#a0aec0')
for i,(a,b) in enumerate(zip(ifa,bgv)):
    ax.text(i-w/2,a+0.6,f"{a:.0f}%",ha='center',fontsize=9); ax.text(i+w/2,b+0.6,f"{b:.0f}%",ha='center',fontsize=9)
ax.set_xticks(x); ax.set_xticklabels(lab); ax.set_ylabel('% identity to yeast Tim44')
ax.set_title('The TIM23 translocase interface of Tim44 is not conserved\nat residue level in either human or C. elegans')
ax.legend(fontsize=8); plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
